stem.en: A student has a clear liquid and wants to show that it is a true solution. Which evidence is best?

text.en: It looks clear, and no particles can be seen in it, even through a hand lens.
It was left for ten minutes and nothing settled to the bottom of the beaker.
The beam shows no path, nothing settles, and nothing stays on filter paper.
It was stirred until the solid could no longer be seen anywhere in the water.

explanation.en: A solution shows no beam path, does not settle and leaves nothing on the paper, so all three tests together are the best evidence. Option a fails because mixture C showed no grains through a lens either. Option b fails because C did not settle either. Option d only says the solid is out of sight, and very fine particles can still be there.

hints.en: Think of milk in water. Which of these checks would milk also pass?
One check is not enough. Look for the option that uses the most evidence.
